findings.message: Question q3 is ambiguous because more than one provided option is a rational zero of the polynomial; the key marks only one correct option.
findings.evidence: Polynomial: 2x^3 - 3x^2 - 11x + 6. Evaluate at x = 3: 2(27) - 3(9) - 11(3) + 6 = 54 - 27 - 33 + 6 = 0. Evaluate at x = 1/2: 2(1/8) - 3(1/4) - 11(1/2) + 6 = 0.25 - 0.75 - 5.5 + 6 = 0. Both x = 3 (option A) and x = 1/2 (option C) are rational zeros, but correctOptionId is set to 'A' only. The multiple-choice item therefore has multiple correct answers among the options, creating ambiguity for a single-correct response format.
